script_text: As a Water sign ruled by Neptune, you feel the tide turn sharply as Mercury conjunct Venus in your 5th House ignites a sudden romantic spark. Midweek, Saturn conjunct Neptune in your 2nd House perfects on June 10, forcing a sober review of income and values. Late week, Thursday through Sunday Uranus in Gemini sextiles Saturn, unlocking innovative cash flow while Venus remains in Cancer smoothing partnership talks. Best day Wednesday — Saturn‑Neptune conjunction perfect for sealing a money deal. Worst day Monday — Sun‑Neptune square clouds judgment. Weekly advice: Write down every financial commitment before Friday to harness Saturn’s discipline. Follow for daily updates.
